title: [review] client.rs: Unreachable unwrap_or fallback
description: The expression `response.retry_after_s().unwrap_or(DEFAULT_503_BACKOFF_S)` has dead code: `retry_after_s()` always returns `Some(...)` for 5.03 responses (see lines 74-80), so the `unwrap_or` branch is unreachable. The fallback is already handled inside `retry_after_s()` at line 78.
